title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MONITORING CROP YIELD FOR AN AGRICULTURAL HARVESTER
abstract: In one aspect, a system for monitoring crop yield for an agricultural harvester includes a material processing system configured to receive a flow of harvested materials, a first sensor configured to generate data indicative of a volume of the flow of harvested materials being directed through the material processing system, and a second sensor configured to generate data indicative of a density of the flow of harvested materials being directed through the material processing system. In addition, the system includes a computing system communicatively coupled to the first and second sensors, with the computing system being configured to determine a mass flow rate of the flow of harvested materials through the material processing system based at least in part on the data received from the first and second sensors.

title: Agricultural Drone and Measuring System for Remaining Quantity of Pesticide
abstract: According to the present invention, disclosed are an agricultural unmanned vehicle and a system for measuring the residual quantity of pesticides, wherein the agricultural unmanned vehicle includes: a supply frame connected to a lower end of a storage part in which the pesticides are stored to supply the pesticides to the outside; and a residual quantity measuring part mounted on one end of the supply frame to measure data of the residual quantity of the pesticides, thereby checking the residual quantity of the pesticides in real time.

title: Multi-rotor spray rod structure and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-rotor spray rod structure and a control method thereof. The multi-rotor spray rod structure comprises a supporting rod 10, the supporting rod 10 is provided with a plurality of rotors, a motor, a connecting flange, a liquid medicine pipeline, nozzles, a GPS module, a visual module 8, a liquid medicine and battery box assembly 11 and a millimeter wave radar 13. A plurality of pairs of rotors are symmetrically distributed on the supporting rod 10, the rotors comprise auxiliary rotors, adjusting rotors and main rotors, and the GPS module is used for providing accurate GPS data for a controller in the path planning and flight stages; the visual module and the millimeter wave radar are also symmetrically fixed to two sides of a multi-rotor spray rod respectively,extend downwards after being fixed by the connecting flange through a bracket, and are used for measuring the movement speed and height of the spray rod; and by controlling the multiple pairs of rotors to be in different postures, when the structure works in a farmland corner area, the rotors can be controlled to conduct yawing motion, meanwhile, the multiple nozzles of the structure are controlled according to the crop density degree, and accurate variable spraying is achieved.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR ESTIMATING EFFECTIVE CROP NITROGEN APPLICATIONS
abstract: A method for effective nitrogen application may include acquiring imagery of an agricultural field and delineating a plurality of management zones within the agricultural field using the imagery of the agricultural field. For each of the management zones within the agricultural field, the method may include receiving soil characteristics at a computing device, the soil characteristics derived from physical soil samples within the management zones. For each of the management zones within the agricultural field, the method may include receiving weather data at the computing device, management practice information and crop cultivar identification at the computing device. The model simulates effects of in-season nitrogen applications on crop yields within each of the management zones.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle for agricultural pesticide spraying
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for agricultural pesticide spraying, relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and aims to solve the problems that when an existing unmanned aerial vehicle works, due to the fact that power supply energy consumption is large, the agricultural cost is increased, and the working efficiency is increased due to the fact that the spraying range is limited. A camera device is arranged at the front end of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, a solar panel is arranged at the upper end of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, a first connecting rod is arranged at the lower end of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, a second connecting rod is arranged at the lower end of the first connecting rod, a container is arranged at the lower end of the second connecting rod, and a disc is arranged at the lower end of the container. The upper end surface of the container is provided with a medicine inlet close to the extension, and two sides of the container are provided with movable plates.

title: Computer-implemented method and system for generating swath coverage patterns for polygonal and pseudo-polygonal shaped fields
abstract: A computer-implemented method and system for generating a swath coverage pattern for a given working area to be traversed by a vehicle or equipment attached thereto.

title: GUIDANCE AND CONTROL OF VEHICLE TRAVEL PATH AND COMPONENTS
abstract: A vehicle, a tool carriage assembly, and a system are disclosed. The vehicle includes drive wheels and a steering assembly which are responsive to control signal(s) to substantially correct a displacement error of the vehicle relative to an intended travel path. The tool carriage assembly includes a support section operatively mounted to a main body for relative movement. The support section is adapted to have mounted thereto a tool unit comprising a tool head. In response to a displacement error of the tool head relative to the intended travel path, the support section is responsive to one or more control signals to move relative to the main body to substantially correct the displacement error of the tool head. The system includes the vehicle having the tool carriage assembly mounted thereto, and a control system for controlling the correction of the displacement errors of the vehicle and the tool head.

title: Farmland area pre-screening method and device based on prior information and deep learning
abstract: The invention provides a farmland area pre-screening method and device based on prior information and deep learning, and the method comprises the following steps: segmenting a satellite image according to grid division, and forming an image block region; removing a non-farmland area in the satellite image in advance based on the multi-source prior information, and reserving the farmland area to form a preliminary screening result; extracting a farmland/non-farmland true value based on the high-precision farmland boundary; performing deep learning based on the farmland/non-farmland true value,classifying the image block regions in the preliminary screening result, judging whether the current image block region belongs to a farmland region or not, removing the non-farmland region, reservingthe farmland region, and forming a pre-screening result; and storing the farmland area pre-screening result according to a grid mode. Through actual tests, it is found that by means of the pre-screening method, the total processing time for high-precision farmland boundary extraction can be shortened to 30% or below of the original processing time.

title: COORDINATED TRAVEL WORK SYSTEM
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make it possible for a manned travel work vehicle to perform work first, and an unmanned travel work vehicle to perform work in the subsequent step while traveling in front of the manned work vehicle.SOLUTION: A coordinated travel work system performs work by a manned work vehicle 100 that performs work in an earlier step first, and an unmanned travel work vehicle 1 that performs work in a subsequent step. The unmanned travel work vehicle includes a control device for measuring a position of a machine body using a satellite positioning system and causing the machine body to automatically travel along a set route. Further, the unmanned travel work vehicle 1 that is traveling obliquely to the front is provided with markers 70R and 70L that function as travel direction indicators for the manned work vehicle that is traveling obliquely to the rear.

title: Automatic variable rate fertilization device based on stepping motor and control method of automatic variable rate fertilization device
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic variable rate fertilization device based on a stepping motor and a control method of the automatic variable rate fertilization device. The automatic variable rate fertilization device comprises a traction device, a material box and a discharge adjusting device, wherein the discharge adjusting device is provided with N fertilizer discharging holes; the upper end of each fertilizer discharging hole is communicated with the material box through a fertilizer guiding pipe; the lower end of each fertilizer discharging hole is connected with a fertilizing pipe; an adjusting plate is further inserted into the discharge adjusting device; the adjusting plate is provided with N material passing holes adapted to the N fertilizer discharging holes; the adjusting plate is engaged with a gear on a rotary shaft of the stepping motor through a rack on one side; the adjusting plate is driven by the stepping motor to move left and right to change the apertures of the fertilizer discharging holes so as to realize variable rate fertilization. The automatic variable rate fertilization device has the obvious effects that the structure is simple; the stepping motor is controlled in real time according to fertilizing information of each land to adjust the fertilizing amount of the automatic variable rate fertilization device; the utilization rate of fertilizer is improved, the influences on an ecological environment are reduced and the popularization cost is low.

title: AGRICULTURAL MACHINE
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine landwirtschaftliche Arbeitsmaschine, insbesondere Traktor, mit mindestens einem Arbeitsaggregat (2) zur Durchführung oder Unterstützung landwirtschaftlicher Arbeit, wobei die landwirtschaftliche Arbeitsmaschine (1) eine Erfassungseinrichtung (4) zur Erfassung von Betriebsparametern und eine Regelungseinrichtung (5) zur Regelung von Arbeitsprozessen der landwirtschaftlichen Arbeitsmaschine (1) aufweist. Es wird vorgeschlagen, dass die Regelungseinrichtung (5) konfiguriert ist, während der Durchführung eines landwirtschaftlichen Arbeitsauftrags eine prädiktive Regelung mindestens eines Arbeitsprozesses der landwirtschaftlichen Arbeitsmaschine (1) auf Basis von Informationen durchzuführen, die mindestens ein Online-Lern-Algorithmus und/oder mindestens ein online lernendes Modell basierend auf den erfassten Betriebsparametern erzeugt.

title: MULTI-SEED PLANTER CONTROL SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR THE SAME
abstract: A method of automatically planting two or more seed types with an agricultural planter includes monitoring a planter location on a prescription map of an agricultural field. The planter includes one or more remotely adjustable planting characteristics. A seed type is selected based on the monitored planter location on the prescription map, the seed type including two or more seed types. The selected seed type is dispensed to one or more seed metering systems of one or more row units based on the selected seed type. As the planter moves in the agricultural one or more of the remotely adjustable planting characteristics of the planter field is dynamically changed based on at least the seed type selected according to the monitored planter location.

title: Seeder automatic control system and control method
abstract: The invention relates to a seeder automatic control system, which comprises a power part capable of rotating positively and negatively and provided with bilateral power output ends; wherein one side of the power part is connected with an operation row seed-metering and fertilizer-discharging part through a first transmission one-way bearing, and the other side thereof is connected with a calibration seed-metering and fertilizer-discharging part through a second transmission one-way bearing; the locking directions of the first transmission one-way bearing and the second transmission one-way bearing are opposite, and the free rotation directions thereof are opposite; a weighing and collecting module is arranged below the seed and fertilizer discharging component; a GPS positioning walking speed acquisition module; the power part is provided with a speed acquisition module and a seeding stepping driver; a CPU module serves as a control center of the whole control system and is in signal connection with the GPS positioning walking speed acquisition module, the speed acquisition module, the seeding stepping driver and the weighing acquisition module. According to the invention, calibration is carried out in an on-line manner, calibration can be completed in a short time, calibration can be completed by one key, and manual weighing and manual weighing data input are not needed.

title: TRAVEL CONTROL METHOD, TRAVEL CONTROL SYSTEM, AND TRAVEL CONTROL PROGRAM
abstract: To provide a travel control method, a travel control system, and a travel control program capable of switching automatic travel to manual travel appropriately.SOLUTION: A receiving processing part 112 receives a user operation for an operation tool which makes a work vehicle 10 perform a predetermined action. A motion processing part 114 makes the work vehicle 10 perform an action corresponding to the user operation for the operation tool. A travel processing part 111 switches automatic travel to manual travel when the amount of change related to the operation tool corresponding to the user operation exceeds a threshold value while the work vehicle 10 is automatically travelling. A setting processing part 116 sets the threshold on the basis of at least one of setting information and work information of the work vehicle 10.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: LIQUID LEVEL SENSOR, LIQUID LEVEL MEASURING DEVICE, LIQUID STORAGE TANK, AND AGRICULTURAL UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLE
abstract: An agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle, comprising a vehicle body (5) and a liquid storage tank. The liquid storage tank comprises a liquid level measuring device and a tank body (4). The liquid level measuring device comprises a liquid level sensor and a processor communicationally connected to the liquid level sensor. The liquid level sensor comprises: a hollow float rod (1); a liquid level measuring plate (2) provided inside the float rod (1) in the length direction of the float rod (1), a plurality of magnetic switches (21) being sequentially arranged along the liquid level measuring plate (2); and a float (3) sleeved outside the float rod (1) and having a magnetic element (31) capable of triggering the magnetic switches (21). The float (3) can move in the length direction of the float rod (1) along with the change of the liquid level, such that the magnetic element (31) can trigger different magnetic switches (21) to measure the liquid level. The liquid level sensor is provided with a plurality of consecutive liquid level mark points, can realize precise liquid level measurement, and has a simple structure.

title: A SELF-PROPELLED APPARATUS FOR OPTIMALLY ANALYSING AND MANAGING FIELDS INTENDED FOR AGRICULTURAL CULTIVATION
abstract: The apparatus (1) for the analysis and management of a field (2), cultivated or intended to be cultivated, comprises: a first detection device (3) adapted for acquiring electromagnetic radiation emitted by vegetation (21) and/or soil (20) of the field (2) and adapted for producing first measurement signals representative of acquisitions performed; a second detection device (4) adapted for spectroscopic analysis of the soil (20) and adapted for producing second measurement signals representative of analyses performed; and a processing unit (6) comprising: a first analysis module (61) configured to obtain first data representative of the vegetation (21) and/or the soil (20) of the field (2), as a function of the first measurement signals; a second analysis module (62) configured to obtain second data of the soil (20) subject to detection, as a function of the second measurement signals; and an evaluation module configured to determine evaluation states of the analysed vegetation and soil, based on the respective first and second data.

title: Compensatory Actions for Automated Farming Machine Failure
abstract: As a farming machine travels through a field of plants, the farming machine operates in a normal operational state to perform one or more farming operations. The farming machine detects an operational failure of a component of the farming machine using measurements obtained from one or more sensors coupled to and monitoring the farming machine. The operational failure of the component impacts performance of a first farming operation of the farming operations. The farming machine configures the farming machine to operate in a remedial operational state. In the remedial operational state, the farming machine diagnoses the operational failure of the component using the obtained measurements. In the remedial operational state, the farming machine selects a solution operation to address the operational failure of the component based on the diagnosis. The farming machine performs the determined solution operation.

title: Method for accurately improving saline-alkali soil paddy field by applying gypsum
abstract: The invention discloses a method for accurately improving a saline-alkali soil paddy field by applying gypsum, and belongs to the field of saline-alkali soil improvement planting. The method comprises the following steps: (1) carrying out dry soil preparation on the saline-alkali soil; (2) carrying out water soil preparation; (3) transplanting rice seedlings; and during rice seedling transplanting, applying gypsum or a mixture of gypsum and a fertilizer into soil below the side of the rice seedling. According to the method, the application amount of the gypsum is greatly reduced, the effective utilization rate of the gypsum is improved, and the loss amount of Ca<2+> hydrolyzed by the gypsum is reduced; according to the method, accurate improvement of root domain soil is achieved, and a good growth environment is created for seedling roots; and the improvement effect of the gypsum on the bottom soil is promoted.

title: DEVICES, SYSTEMS, AND METHODS FOR PREDICTING THE GROWTH OF URBAN LANDSCAPE TREES
abstract: The subject invention pertains to systems and methods for cost effective evaluation of the suitability of tree growth in a planting area before planting. Factors considered include whether the water and heat conditions of the area to be planted are suitable for the growth and development of the trees to be cultivated and how long the nutrient content in the soil can support the growth of the tree. The invention provides a “plug-and-play” urban landscape tree growth predictor. By inserting a “plunger” with a specialized sensor into the area to be planted, the instrument can automatically capture environmental data to drive the tree growth model, thus quickly simulating the tree's future growth. Through this method, the future growth trend of trees can be predicted and analyzed before planting to reduce the growth risk after planting.

title: Agricultural nutrient application using real-time spectroscopic analysis of live crop
abstract: An agricultural nutrient applicator includes a container and a nutrient distribution assembly operably coupled to the container to deliver a nutrient from the container. A spectroscopic reflectance crop sense system is provided that includes an optical window. A presentation assembly is mounted to the agricultural nutrient applicator and is configured to position live plants in a field proximate the optical window of the spectroscopic reflectance crop sense system as the agricultural nutrient applicator moves. A controller is coupled to the spectroscopic reflectance crop sense system and the nutrient distribution assembly. The controller is configured to obtain, from the spectroscopic reflectance crop sense system, information indicative of a measured nutrient level in the live plants and determine a remedial nutrient amount based on the measured nutrient level and a target nutrient level. The controller controls the nutrient distribution assembly based on the remedial amount.

title: METHOD FOR CONTROLLING A SOIL WORKING MEANS BASED ON IMAGE PROCESSING AND RELATED SYSTEM
abstract: The invention relates to a method (100) for controlling a soil working means, based on an image processing. Such a soil working means comprises a locomotion member (201) and a working member (202). The method comprises the steps of: acquiring (101) at least one digital image of the soil by means of digital image acquisition means (203) installed on the working means; processing (102), by means of an electronic processing unit (204), the at least one digital image acquired by performing at least one convolution operation on the digital image by means of a trained neural network (300; 400; 500); obtaining (103), by means of the electronic processing unit, at least one synthetic soil descriptor based on such a processing; - generating (104), by means of the electronic processing unit, at least one control signal of the locomotion member or of the working member based on the synthetic soil descriptor.

title: COMPOSITE ENERGY EMISSION INFORMATION SYSTEM FOR IMPROVED SAFETY TO SITE PERSONNEL
abstract: A method of using information about the public telecommunications industry comprises establishing a computer accessible database storing energy transmissions information including site specific physical locations and utilization characteristics of wireless transmitting facilities that are currently operating in the public telecommunications industry, providing Internet access to the database information to registered users and preparing and downloading MPE overlay maps, EME dispersion simulation information and utilization characteristics reports from the database information of the site specific locations, upon request by the registered users. Site specific lock-out/tag-out orders and subsequent releases are obtained and issued for site specific management, upon request by the registered users.

title: BALE BINDER WITH A DEVICE FOR FEEDING ADDITIVES
abstract: PURPOSE: A bale binder with an additive dosing machine is provided to remarkably save the amount of a leavening agent used and to improve the palatability of silage. CONSTITUTION: A bale binder with an additive dosing machine includes a photosensor (200), a bale completeness sensor (210), a pump motor, a flux sensor (600), a micom part (100), a proximity sensor, an oil pressure sensor (230), and a filter (400). The photosensor senses whether crops is put in or not. The bale completeness sensor senses the completeness of a lump of bale. The pump motor pumps additions in an additive bath. The flux sensor senses the amount of additives inputted from the pump motor. The micom part receives detection signals from each sensor and conducts internal treatments. The oil pressure sensor senses oil pressure formed in the oil pressure line of a cylinder for opening and closing a jetting door. The filter prevents pipes from being clogged. [Reference numerals] (10) Additive storage bath; (100) Micom; (11) Pick up part; (11) Input part; (120) Controller; (130) Display part; (140) Warning part; (150) GPS module; (160) Memory part; (170) Transmission part; (20) Valve; (200) Photo sensor; (210) Veil completeness sensor; (220) Proximity sensor; (230) Oil pressure sensor; (30,31,32) Nozzle; (300,310,320) Solenoid valve; (400) Filter; (500) Pump motor; (600) Flux sensor

title: Harvesting header segment display and map
abstract: Method and apparatus for presenting information associated with a multi-segment header of an agricultural harvester. The operational states of the segments are monitored and used to present information. Examples of presented information include graphics depicting which segments are operational and which segments are non-operational, crop coverage maps, and crop yield maps.

title: Methods and systems for seed planting management and control
abstract: A seed planting system providing optimal seed spacing in an agricultural field. The seed planting system includes a mobile seed planter having one or more planting shoes, or members being adapted for towing by a farm vehicle or being self-propelled. Sensors, disposed proximate to respective planting shoes, detect seed planting events and send corresponding signals to a computer. Contemporaneously, a geospatial locator acquires, and transmits to the computer, the geospatial location of each planted seed. The computer correlates the geospatial location data with the seed deposition data and generates a seed distribution profile indicating the location of each seed planted in a zone of interest to enable the control of speed spacing.

title: Agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle sprinkling device and agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle sprinkling, and particularly relates to an agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle sprinkling device and an agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle. The agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle sprinkling device comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle undercarriage, a base frame component, a liquid storage component and a liquid conveying mechanism, wherein the base frame component is detachably connected to the unmanned aerial vehicle undercarriage; and the liquid storage component is placed on the base frame component for storing sprinkled pesticide liquid. The agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle sprinkling device has a compact and uniform structure, directly fixes the base frame component on the unmanned aerial vehicle undercarriage to finish the fixing of the sprinkling device disclosed by the invention, and has the advantages of being convenient to mount and dismount. In addition, the sprinkling device is simple and effective in structural design, and can finish sprinkling work. Since the sprinkling device is fixed on the unmanned aerial vehicle undercarriage, the internal structure of the unmanned aerialvehicle is not affected, and the service life of the unmanned aerial vehicle is prolonged. Meanwhile, requirements on the type of the unmanned aerial vehicle are low, so that the agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle sprinkling device is high in applicability and can be used on the unmanned aerial vehicle with the undercarriage.

title: Balanced fertilization method for planting of coffea arabica
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant fertilization, and relates to a plant nutrition balanced fertilization technology, in particular to a balanced fertilization method for economic plant coffea arabica in the cultivating process. The balanced fertilization method for planting of the coffea arabica comprises the following steps: A, field planting and basic fertilizer fertilization; B, soil sample detection; C, additional fertilizer preparation and application; and D, leaf surface top-dressing. Compared with the traditional fertilization method, the balanced fertilization method performs fertilization respectively in different periods according to the characteristics of fertilizers required by coffea arabica, so as to improve the effectiveness of fertilizers; and microelements are supplemented, so that favorable nutrition is provided for the growth of the coffee plant, high and stable yield is ensured, and the yield can be increased by 15-18 percent on the basis of the original yield. The balanced fertilization method is combined with the earth surface to apply a large amount of elements and leaf surface spraying microelements, so as to meet the needs of coffea arabica to different elements, greatly improves the effectiveness of fertilizers, obviously improves the yield of coffea arabica, reduces losses of fertilizers, and saves the production cost.

title: Linked mode for a multi-axis machine control
abstract: A tool control system includes actuators to move the tool, a controller to permit either manual or automatic tool operation, and an output configured to display information pertaining to a position of the tool. In addition, the tool can be moved in either an independent or linked mode, the latter such that during tool operation, both sides of the tool can move substantially in unison with one another, or during system setup, detectors used to ensure coordination with of the tool to a known benchmark can move substantially in unison with one another. The controller can display either single or multiple numbers related to the tool position, and can accept either single or multiple user inputs to move the tool by a user-determined or system-determined amount.

title: COMBINE-HARVESTER
abstract: To provide a combine-harvester capable of appropriately performing automatic operation in lodged areas by creating a travel route according to lodged states of grain culms.SOLUTION: A combine-harvester 1 includes a control device 50 and the control device 50 is functioned as a travel route creation section 62 for creating a travel route corresponding to a field and an automatic drive control section 63 for controlling automatic travel and automatic reaping according to the travel route. Alternatively, the control device 50 is functioned as a lodge information setup section 61 for automatically or manually setting up lodging information relating to lodged areas where grain culms are lodged in the field. The travel route creation section 62 creates the travel route including reaping of the grain culms in the lodged areas based on the lodging information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Intelligent agricultural planting system based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent agricultural planting system based on Internet of Things. The system comprises a base and vertical plates, the left side and the right side of the upper end of the base are both fixedly connected with the vertical plates, a rotating assembly is arranged above the base, and the rotating assembly comprises a first rotating shaft, a motor, frames, first clampingblocks, a straight gear, a first bevel gear and a second bevel gear; and the multiple frames are located at the front ends and the rear ends of the inner sides of the vertical plates correspondingly,and the first clamping blocks are fixedly connected to the front sides and the rear sides of the inner walls of the frames. The intelligent agricultural planting system based on the Internet of Things is scientific and reasonable in structure and safe and convenient to use, through cooperation of the motor, the first rotating shaft, the frames, sliding blocks, a second rotating shaft, a transverse plate, frames and crops, the transverse plate can be kept horizontal in the rotating period, and then a user can place the crops needing to be cultivated into corresponding slotted holes; and the problem that a multi-layer planting system is easy to cause difficulty when the crops are placed at a high layer is avoided.

title: Headland guidance tracks for farm machinery
abstract: System and methods for generating a work plan for a headland of an agricultural field (e.g., the portion of the agricultural field that is used by an agricultural machine to perform edge turns while working a main work partition of the field). A field boundary polygon indicative of a workable area of the agricultural field is segmented into multiple segments including a headland polygon and a work partition polygon. A seed track is generated based on a shape of a portion of the boundary of the headland polygon that is shared in common with the boundary of the field boundary polygon. The work plan is generated by replicating the seed track at a defined spacing throughout the headland polygon. In some implementations, the agricultural machine is operated autonomously or semi-autonomously to work the headland area based on the defined work plan.

title: Feeding mechanism, sowing device and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a feeding mechanism, a sowing device and an unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the field of material conveying. The feeding mechanism comprises a feeding shell, a mounting shell and a feeding piece; the feeding shell is provided with an inlet and an outlet; the mounting shell is arranged at the outlet in a protruding mode in the direction away from the feeding shell, a mounting piece is arranged at the end, away from the feeding shell, of the mounting shell, a discharging opening extending to the mounting piece from the outlet is formed in the peripheral side of the mounting shell, and the discharging opening communicates with the outlet; the feeding piece penetrates through the outlet to be matched with the installation piece and is used for enabling materials input from the inlet to pass through the outlet and the discharging port to be output. Compared with a discharging opening formed in the vertical end face, the discharging opening of the feeding mechanism is located in the peripheral side of the mounting shell and extends to the outlet from the mounting piece at the end, the area of the discharging opening is larger, materials are easier to output, and blocking is not prone to occurring; and the discharge port is located on the peripheral side of the mounting shell, the adhered materials can be separated from the discharge port from the peripheral side under the action of gravity after being stacked to a certain degree, the discharge port is not prone to being blocked, and the material blocking problem of the discharge port can be further solved.

title: Water delivery and water retention integrated intelligent system based on big data analysis and used for desertification control
abstract: The invention discloses a water delivery and water retention integrated intelligent system based on big data analysis and used for desertification control. The system comprises an Internet-of-Things monitoring module, an intelligent control module, an underground drip irrigation module and a water absorption and retention module. The Internet-of-Things monitoring module transmits information datasuch as air temperature/wet soil moisture and soil temperature/humidity acquired in real time to the intelligent control module in real time through a data transmission module, gives moisture contentcurrently required by crops and existing moisture content of soil in combination with seeded crops and varieties and sends a data signal command controlling a drip irrigation switch to the undergrounddrip irrigation module when the moisture content of the soil is insufficient, accurate underground drip irrigation is realized, and the water absorption and retention module enhances water retentionproperty of the soil, improves soil structures and reduce water and nutrient loss of the soil. The soil environment is monitored in combination with Internet-of-Things equipment, the water and fertilizer use amounts for underground drip irrigation are adjusted intelligently on the basis of big data analysis, the water resource is saved, the water utilization efficiency is improved, and the systemis more economical and more efficient.

title: Generating digital models of relative yield of a crop based on nitrate values in the soil
abstract: A computer implemented method for generating digital models of relative crop yield based on nitrate values in the soil is provided. In an embodiment, nitrate measurements from soil during a particular portion of a crop's development and corresponding crop yields are received by an agricultural intelligence computing system. Based, at least in part, on the nitrate measurements and corresponding crop yields, the system determines maximum yields for each location of a plurality of locations. The system then converts each crop yield value into a relative crop yield by dividing the crop yield value by the maximum crop yield for the location. Using the relative crop yields and the corresponding nitrate values in the soil, the system generates a digital model of relative crop yield as a function of nitrate in the soil during the particular portion of the crop's development. When the system receives nitrate measurements from soil in a particular field during the particular portion of a crop's development, the system computes a relative yield value for the particular field using the model of relative crop yield.

title: System and method for detecting disk gang plugging on a tillage implement
abstract: A tillage implement includes a plurality of disk gangs, with each disk gang including a shaft and a plurality of disks spaced apart from each other along the shaft. Furthermore, the tillage implement includes a plurality of load sensors configured to generate data indicative of loads being applied to the plurality of disk gangs and a computing system communicatively coupled to the plurality of sensors. In this respect, the computing system is configured to determine a total load being applied to each disk gang based on the data generated by the plurality of load sensors. Additionally, the computing system is configured to determine an average load per disk being applied to each disk gang based on the determined total loads. Moreover, the computing system is configured to determine a plug status value for each disk gang based on the determined average loads per disk.

title: Method and system for augmenting a guidance system with a path sensor
abstract: In an automatic vehicle position control system, such as a satellite-based agricultural implement steering system, the satellite-based steering information is adjusted with information obtained from one or more path sensors to facilitate the automatic nudging of the vehicle to take account of inaccurate tracking of the agricultural implement relative to its tractor, terrain variations, and inaccuracies in the satellite-based steering system.

title: Method for improving seed selection of watermelon polyploid
abstract: The invention relates to a method for improving the polyploidy cultivation of water melon, wherein it comprises that: immerging diploid seed into normal-temperature water for 6-8h; immerging it with 0.05-0.1% colchicines for 16-20h; using wet towel to pack and putting it into cultivate box at 28-32Deg. C to bud for 48-72h; planting into cavity disc; cultivating in green room; putting seed into artificial intelligent cultivate box at 12-18De. g C, taking off the growing point; processing with colchicines, dropping it one time each day, processing for 4-6 days; inducing polyploidy, growing new growing point, checking polyploidy, pollinating, and storing the seed. The invention can improve induce rate of polyploidy water melon.

title: Walnut fruit maturity clustering identification method, device and system and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a walnut fruit maturity clustering recognition method, device and system and a storage medium, a walnut fruit maturity clustering recognition model is constructed through an unsupervised learning technology in artificial intelligence deep learning, automatic clustering recognition of walnut maturity is realized, and internal quality of walnut fruits with different maturity is measured. The relationship between the internal quality and the external phenotype of the walnut fruits is explained, the fuzzy relationship between the maturity and the internal quality of the walnuts is established, the optimal harvesting maturity is determined according to the identified maturity and the corresponding internal quality, and a brand new technical thought is provided for intelligent picking of the walnuts.

title: Low-contrast fog drop image recognition method
abstract: The invention discloses a low-contrast fog drop image recognition method, which comprises the following steps of: performing gray operation on an acquired sample image to change the sample image into a gray image, performing threshold binaryzation on the gray image, segmenting a background image and a fog drop image, performing median filtering on the segmented fog drop image to obtain a smooth integral image, and performing image segmentation on the integral image. Edge detection is carried out on the obtained whole image, then pit corrosion and pit expansion are carried out, fog drops with small particles have more obvious shapes, then contour detection and drawing are carried out, the outer boundary of each fog drop is obtained, and distribution of the fog drops can be clearly recognized. According to the fog drop image recognition method, fog drops on water sensitive paper or coated paper can be detected, the situation that the fog drops are seriously adhered is made up, small-particle images can be accurately recognized, and the recognition accuracy is optimized. In addition, the fog drop image recognition method can better detect the spraying effect, thereby promoting the development of precision agriculture.

title: Rack of multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, agricultural plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle, and control method
abstract: A rack of a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, an agricultural plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle and a control method are provided. The rack of a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a center body (11), a plurality of arms (12), a plurality of rotor wing power devices (13), a plurality of nozzles (14) and a plurality of angle adjusting mechanisms (17). The rotor wing power devices (13) are mounted on the arms (12) and used for providing flight power to the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle. The nozzles (14) are installed below the multiple arms (12) correspondingly and located below the rotor wing power devices (13) correspondingly. The angle adjusting mechanisms (17) are installed on the arms (12), are used for rotatably connecting the arms and the center body, and can adjust the included angle between each arm and the center body so that the spraying direction of each nozzle is a direction towards the lower inclined part of the center body. The agricultural plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle can ensure that more tree branches and leaves can be sprayed with farm chemicals and the uniformity of farm chemical spraying on trees by unmanned aerial vehicles can be improved.

title: Automation control management system using drones and their methods
abstract: The present invention relates to an automation control management system using drones and a method thereof. The automation control management system using drones comprises: one or more drone units that move to an area in which a crop is planted through pre-set coordinate data, then film the crop to secure image data, and spray an agricultural chemical to the area; a management server that receives the image data secured by the drone to diagnose whether a pest or weed is generated in the area based on deep learning and recognize the state of growth of the crop, matches the agricultural chemical according to at least one of a type or the state of growth of the generated pest or weed, and controls the drone units to move to the area and spray the agricultural chemical at a set flight date; and one or more drone stations that store one or more agricultural chemicals, inject the matched agricultural chemical into the drone units, and charge a battery. The present invention has an advantage of automatically performing pest control work matched for each pest and weed.

title: Intelligent constant-temperature flowerpot based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent flowerpots and in particular to an intelligent constant-temperature flowerpot based on Internet of Things. The flowerpot comprises a flowerpot, a soilzone, a control zone and a fertilizer water zone, wherein the soil zone is arranged inside the flowerpot; the control zone and the fertilizer water zone are arranged below the soil zone and are distributed in parallel; an adjusting device is arranged on the flowerpot; a conversion temperature adjusting device is arranged on the adjusting device; a sensing device is arranged inside the soil zone;a control device is arranged inside the control zone. Due to addition of partition plates and vertical columns, fertilizer water in the fertilizer water zone can be cleared off when the flowerpot is not used for a long time, and then impurities such as bacteria are not generated in the fertilizer water zone; a fine sand layer is arranged in the interlayer of the flowerpot, so that humidity loss caused by temperature variation is reduced; instruments for lighting, water ejection and cooling can be automatically switched according to cooperation of an Internet of Things receiver and a controller, and thus high automation is achieved; due to adoption of a transverse plate made of woven bamboo strips, intense sunshine exposure of plants can be alleviated to a certain extent.

title: Digital modeling and tracking of agricultural fields for implementing agricultural field trials
abstract: A system for implementing a trial in one or more fields is provided. In an embodiment, a system receives field data for a plurality of agricultural fields, identifies one or more target agricultural fields, and sends, to a field manager computing device associated with the one or more target agricultural fields, a trial participation request. The server receives data indicating acceptance of the trial participation request from the field manager computing device. The server determines one or more locations on the one or more target agricultural fields for implementing a trial and sends data identifying the one or more locations to the field manager computing device. When the system receives application data, the system determines whether the one or more target agricultural fields are in compliance with the trial. The system receives result data for the trial and computes a benefit value for the trial.

title: Multi-source information fusion and intelligent decision autonomous-flight plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-source information fusion and intelligent decision autonomous-flight plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle and a control method thereof. The multi-source informationfusion and intelligent decision autonomous-flight plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an information acquisition system, a surface control station and a plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle; the information acquisition system includes an unmanned aerial vehicle acquisition system, a weather acquisition system and an internet disease condition acquisition server; the unmanned aerial vehicle acquisition system includes a high-spectral camera, airborne radar, a CCD (charge coupled device) camera, and a GPS (global positioning system), a Beidou system and an acquisition unmanned aerial vehicle body; the weather acquisition system includes a wind speed sensor, a wind direction sensor and a weather acquisition controller; the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle comprisesan unmanned aerial vehicle body, a pesticide application system and a navigation system; all the acquisition unmanned aerial vehicle body, the weather acquisition control unit, the internet disease condition acquisition server and the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle body are in wireless communication connection with the surface control station. The problems are solved that, for instance,an existing plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle acquires little information, crop information, weather information and operation information are not fused, and intelligent precision automated pesticide application is difficult to implement.

title: Method is for moving autonomous agricultural machine over plot of ground and involves determining size of angle between machine reference surface and plot reference surface
abstract: The method is for moving an autonomous agricultural machine (1) over a plot of ground (2) and involves determining the size of the angle between a machine reference surface and a plot reference surface. Displacement of the machine makes use of a route information system (5). This system uses gradient data per position in the plot of ground. The determination of the size of the angle takes place during the movement of the machine and the angle size is compared with a threshold value. For angle measurement a meter in the form of an electronic water pass is used. The machine incorporates a component (7) for comparison of the size of the angle with a threshold value. It also incorporates equipment for its steering, at least with the aid of data from the angle meter (6).

title: Harvester having a measuring device for grain number detection
abstract: A harvester includes a measuring device for detecting a grain number of a crop flow, in which a sensor of the measuring device detects via a measuring signal kernels impacting an impact surface of the measuring device, and a processing unit of the measuring device is arranged to detect and calculate the grain number by using the measuring signal, wherein the rising edges of the measuring signal are recorded and form a measurement for the grain number. Furthermore, the measuring device for detecting a grain number and method for detecting a grain number are also provided.

title: Grain quality sensor
abstract: A grain quality sensor comprising a photosite array, an illumination source, a filter, and an electronics module, wherein the illumination source directs light onto a crop sample, wherein the filter limits passage of light into different parts of the photosite array such that certain locations on the photosite array only receive certain wavelengths of light reflected or fluoresced by the crop sample, wherein an electronics module is electrically connected to the photosite array and capable of determining which parts of the photosite array received light and the wavelengths of the light received, wherein the electronics module can analyze the optical data received by the photosite array, and wherein the analysis of the optical data is used to determine the composition of the crop sample.

title: Aircraft spraying status intelligent control system
abstract: The invention discloses an aircraft spraying status intelligent control system. The aircraft spraying status intelligent control system comprises a main controller which is connected with a flight control system of an aircraft, a two-dimensional laser scanning module which is connected with the main controller, a spraying nozzle which is connected with a pesticide storing tank by a pipeline, a spraying controller which receives commands of the main controller to control the volume of pesticide sprayed by the spraying nozzle, and a GPS which is connected with the main controller. The GPS receives location information transmitted by satellite, and sends the location information to the main controller for analyzing and processing. According to the aircraft spraying status intelligent controlsystem, the aim of accurate pesticide spraying is achieved, the false target rate of spraying is lowered, environment pollution is reduced, and great significance to the development of modern agriculture is achieved.

title: AGRICULTURAL MACHINE AGGREGATE
abstract: FIELD: agriculture.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to agriculture. An agricultural machine aggregate is proposed, containing at least one tractor with a tractor control device containing a set of rules for controlling the tractor, and at least one tractor-adapted mounted implement with a mounted implement control device containing a set of rules for controlling the mounted implement, and equipped with a driver assistance system that optimizes the operation of the tractor and/or the corresponding mounted implement and containing a computing module and at least one display module. The computing module is designed to process the information generated by the built-in sensor systems, external information and information recorded in the computing module, and the driver assistance system is designed in such a way that it forms an automatic device for adjusting the tractor and an automatic device for adjusting the mounted implement. The automatic tractor setting device contains a set of rules for the automatic tractor setting device and is designed to form, based on the specified set of rules for the automatic tractor setting device, one or more control signals for the tractor control device to control at least one aspect of the tractor operation. The automatic setting device of the mounted implement is designed to generate one or more control signals for the control device of the mounted implement to control at least one aspect of the operation of the mounted implement. The automatic setting device of the tractor and the automatic setting device of the mounted implement are designed to operate independently of each other to ensure the optimization of the operation of the tractor and the mounted implement.EFFECT: increased efficiency and speed of optimizing of the settings of tractor and the corresponding mounted implement, both individually and in combination with each other.17 cl, 4 dwg

title: IMPACT SENSING SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR AN AGRICULTURAL HEADER
abstract: An impact sensor system for a header of an agricultural system includes a first sensor vibrationally connected to a deck plate of the header, wherein the first sensor is configured to generate first signals in response to detection of vibrations due to initial contact between a crop and the deck plate of the header. The impact sensor system also includes a second sensor vibrationally connected to the deck plate of the header and positioned forward of the first sensor, wherein the second sensor is configured to generate second signals in response to detection of the vibrations due to the initial contact between the crop and the deck plate of the header.

title: AUTOMATIC ROTATING AGRICULTURAL SYSTEM
abstract: The disclosed invention provides an automatic, rotating agricultural system that rotates around a central pivot point in either a full rotation or a partial arc to irrigate, plant and/or harvest a field. The agricultural system includes a center pivot frame, a plurality of frame segments connected to each other, and a feed storage bin connected to the center pivot frame and the frame segments. The frame segment includes a section frame including wheels to enable movements, a cutter trolley beam extends in a radial direction of the section frame, a cutterhead coupled to the cutter trolley beam to cut forage or crop, a radial conveyor that moves the cut forage or crop in the radial direction of the section frame, and a cutter conveyor that moves the cut forage or crop from the cutterhead to the radial conveyor.

title: Photoelectric sensor for seed dispensing system
abstract: A seed dispensing system is provided with a photoelectric sensor for monitoring the dispensing of seeds from a seed dispenser comprising a discharge conveyor with conveyor flights that transport seeds through the seed dispenser. The sensor outputs a signal representative of obstructions to the flow of light in an optical path of the sensor, and a computing unit is adapted to distinguish portions of the output signal that are attributable to the passage of one or more seeds from portions of the output signal that are attributable to the passage of a conveyor flight.

title: Cultivation method for organic Longjing tea
abstract: The invention discloses a cultivation method for organic Longjing tea. The method comprises the steps of tea garden establishment, excellent breed selection, soil preparation and fertilization, planting, post-planting management and the like. An attribute database is established by collecting a pest quantity, a harm degree, various meteorological factors and the like, and information of pest outbreak, harm, migratory flight, diffusion and the like is established by utilizing a geographic information system, thereby providing a basis for biological control; and in a process of carrying out biological control on organic green tea, a chemical fertilizer, a pesticide and a plant growth regulator are not applied in the whole process, so that the obtained organic green tea is environment-friendly and pollution-free, and passes organic food certification.

title: Verfahren zum Betreiben mindestens einer Arbeitsmaschine in einem Arbeitsumfeld
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein Verfahren zum Betreiben mindestens einer Arbeitsmaschine (100) in einem Arbeitsumfeld (110). Das Verfahren umfasst einen Schritt des Einlesens von Fusionskartendaten, einen Schritt des Bestimmens eines Steuersignals und einen Schritt des Ausgebens des Steuersignals. Im Schritt des Einlesens repräsentieren die Fusionskartendaten eine aus mindestens zwei maschinenbezogenen Einzelkarten fusionierte Karte des Arbeitsumfeldes (110). Dabei weist die fusionierte Karte Informationen über einen geschützten Umgebungsbereich (120) hinsichtlich einer Annäherung an die Arbeitsmaschine (100) und über einen geschützten weiteren Umgebungsbereich (115) hinsichtlich einer Annäherung an die weitere Arbeitsmaschine (105) in dem Arbeitsumfeld (110) auf. Im Schritt des Bestimmens wird das Steuersignal unter Verwendung der Fusionskartendaten bestimmt. Dabei repräsentiert das Steuersignal zumindest einen Steuerparamater für die Arbeitsmaschine (100) und zusätzlich oder alternativ für die weitere Arbeitsmaschine (105). Im Schritt des Ausgebens wird das Steuersignal an eine Schnittstelle zu mindestens einer Betriebseinrichtung (155, 160) der Arbeitsmaschine (100) und zusätzlich oder alternativ der weiteren Arbeitsmaschine (105) ausgegeben, um die Arbeitsmaschine (100) und zusätzlich oder alternativ die weitere Arbeitsmaschine (105) zu betreiben.

title: Agricultural planting pesticide spraying accurate positioning unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural planting pesticide spraying accurate positioning unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a vehicle body. A pesticide liquid tank is fixedly installed at the top of the vehicle body. A water pump is fixedly installed at the top of the pesticide liquid tank. One end of the water pump is fixedly connected with a rubber hose. An adjustingboard is fixedly installed at the top of the vehicle body. A rotary shaft is rotationally installed at the top of the adjusting board. A disc is fixedly installed at the top of the rotary shaft. A cylindrical block is welded to the disc. A supporting column is fixedly installed at the top of the adjusting board. A swing rod is rotationally installed on the supporting column. A rail groove is formed in the swing rod. The cylindrical block and the rail groove are in sliding connection. A spraying device is fixedly installed at one end of the top of the swing rod. The end, away from the water pump, of the rubber hose is fixedly connected with a nozzle. A motor is fixedly installed at the top of the adjusting board. Swing motion of the spraying device on the pesticide spraying unmanned aerialvehicle is achieved, the pesticide spraying range is enlarged, the pesticide spraying efficiency is improved, use is convenient, and popularization is easy.

title: JOINT ASSEMBLY FOR AN AGRICULTURAL IMPLEMENT
abstract: A joint assembly for an agricultural implement includes a pin configured to pivotally couple an end of a wing frame to a main frame. The pin enables the wing frame to pivot about a longitudinal axis relative to the main frame. The joint assembly also includes a housing having a slot. The pin is disposed within the slot and configured to translate vertically within the slot to enable the wing frame to move vertically relative to the main frame.

title: System and method for determining operational status of a tillage implement
abstract: A tillage implement includes a computing system configured to determine the total load being applied to a disk gang of the implement based on data generated by the one or more load sensors. Additionally, the computing system is configured to determine a normalized number of disks on the disk gang based on the surface area of each disk on the disk gang that is in contact with soil in a field across which the tillage implement is traveling. Moreover, the computing system is configured to determine an average load per disk being applied to the disk gang based on the determined total load and the determined normalized number of disks. In addition, the computing system is configured to determine an operational status of the tillage implement based on the determined average load per disk.

title: Grain flow real-time monitoring device and method and combine harvester
abstract: The invention provides a grain flow real-time monitoring device and method and a combine harvester. The grain flow real-time monitoring device comprises a connecting support, a mounting support, multiple groups of flow monitoring units, an acquisition module and a controller, wherein the connecting support is used for being mounted above a grain outlet shell of a spiral hoisting auger, and one endof the mounting support is connected with the connecting support; the flow monitoring units are mounted on the connecting support through the mounting support and connected with the acquisition module, and the acquisition module is connected with the controller; the flow monitoring units are used for monitoring grain flow signals and vibration signals of the combine harvester during operation andtransmitting the acquired signals to the acquisition module, and the acquisition module is used for converting the received signals into digital signals and transmitting the digital signals to the controller. On the basis of simulation analysis of crop grain flow, a corresponding flow monitoring unit arrangement scheme is adopted, and through signal differential processing, interference of harvester vibration on monitoring signals can be effectively solved, so that accurate monitoring data is obtained.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR CREATING CROP INPUT REQUIREMENT MAPS FOR SITE SPECIFIC FARMING
abstract: A system and method for creating crop input requirement maps for site-specific farming. Crop input requirement maps contain a prescription of crop inputs for each section of a field. The prescription is used to create an application map. The first step is to input recommendation equations (124) into a mapping system. Next, a field attribute map containing various agronomic data is accessed by the mapping system (100). The field attribute map includes data such as soil test values, elevation, desired crop yield , soil survey, as-applied data (116), yield monitor data, and other information. The final step combines (100) the recommendation equations (124) and field attribute maps to create a prescription of crop inputs for each section of a field.

title: Agricultural chemical application monitoring and accurate flow rate control device and method
abstract: The invention relates to an agricultural chemical application monitoring and accurate flow rate control device and method. The device comprises a chemical mixing device, a flow rate meter, a nozzle, acontroller and an infrared remote sensing detector, on-spot preparing and using of agricultural chemical is achieved by the chemical mixing device, the agricultural chemical is sprayed by passing through a primary pipeline to reach the nozzle, remote sensing images of a field are detected by the infrared remote sensing detector, and a corresponding application prescription map and an applicationstrategy are generated after data analysis processing is conducted; agricultural chemical spraying is controlled by the controller according to the application prescription map and the application strategy, the application concentration is adjusted by controlling a water pump and a chemical filling pump, application situation is monitored in real time according to signals transmitted by a camera,an ultrasound radar, the flow meter and a velocity sensor to adjust the application concentration and the flow rate, and therefore accurate application and flow rate control can be achieved. Accordingto the device, computation of the concentration and amount of the chemical can be conducted according to disease and pest situation of the field, feedback is conducted in real time, accurate application is conducted to improve the utilization rate of the agricultural chemical, and agricultural residue and waste caused by blindly application are prevented.

title: Vineyard precise drip irrigation control system based on dynamic neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a vineyard precise drip irrigation control system based on a dynamic neural network. The control system comprises a cloud precise drip irrigation control system, an irrigation device, and various sensors, wherein the various sensors comprise a miniature weather station used for collecting weather information and soil sensors arranged at different depths of crop roots to collect humidity information of soil; the cloud precise drip irrigation control system designs an irrigation demand prediction system based on RNN-LSTM by utilizing internal self-circulation cells of a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN)and by combining a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM); the irrigation demand prediction system takes past soil volumetric water content, rainfall, and weather data as input, and outputs a predicted value of the soil volumetric water content; the predicted value is inverted to an actual scale by post-processing. According to the method, the soil volumetric water content is precisely predicted in advance for a period of time, so that the irrigation time and the irrigation volume are determined, and a precise automatic irrigation is realized.

title: Operating part working state monitoring system of combined corn harvester
abstract: The invention provides an operating part working state monitoring system of a combined corn harvester and belongs to the technical field of agricultural machine testing. A main controller and a power supply of the operating part working state monitoring system are fixedly connected in a harvester cab, an operating seed sensor is fixedly connected to the outer side of a front wheel of the harvester, a snapping roll rotation speed sensor is fixedly connected beside a snapping roll transmission gear of a snapping roll, a diver ground clearance height sensor is fixedly connected below a driver, a peeling roll rotation speed sensor is fixedly connected to the outer side of a peeling roll auxiliary speed measurement gear of a peeling roll, an elevator rotation speed sensor is fixedly connected to the side of an elevator of the harvester, and a GPS receiver is fixedly connected to the top of the corn harvester. The operating seed sensor, the snapping roll rotation speed sensor, the diver ground clearance height sensor, the peeling roll rotation speed sensor, the elevator rotation speed sensor, an alarm system, a display module and the GPS receiver are controlled by the main controller. The operating part working state monitoring system can timely find a fault of a key part of the harvester and provide preconditions for quick and convenient fault removal and can further provide effective references for management and scheduling of agricultural machinery.

title: Method for assisting user in plant maintenance and computer system
abstract: The invention relates to a computer-executable method for assisting a user in plant maintenance. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a plant added by the user; determining a maintenance task of the plant at least according to the type of the plant, the planting site of the plant and the current time; and prompting the maintenance task of the plant to a user.

title: Method and system for implementing automatic vehicle control with parameter-driven disengagement
abstract: Embodiments of the present invention recite a method and system for implementing automatic vehicle control with parameter-driven disengagement. In one embodiment, a course for a vehicle is determined along which the vehicle is to be automatically guided. An indication is received that a pre-defined parameter has been exceeded In response to receiving the indication, the generation of vehicle control commands is then suspended.

title: Harvester with bulldozing device and bulldozing method
abstract: The invention provides a bulldozing method of multiple harvesters. The bulldozing method comprises the following steps that (a) a dozer blade mounting component and a driving mounting component are mounted on a machine body; (b) a dozer blade is hinged to the dozer blade mounting component; (c) a lifting driving device is respectively connected to the driving mounting component and the dozer blade; and (d) the dozer blade is driven to ascend or descend through the lifting driving device so as to level the field.

title: DEVICE FOR GUIDING A TRAILER HITCHED TO A VEHICLE, AND CORRESPONDING METHOD
abstract: The present invention relates to a device (1) for guiding a trailer hitched to a motorized vehicle. The guiding device (1) comprises: - a positioning means (8), - a visual analysis means (10) configured to provide a determined trajectory, and - a control means (14) receiving the trajectory determined by the visual analysis means (10), and configured to control the positioning means (8). The guiding device (1) also comprises a locating means (12), and the control means (14) comprises a storage means (18) configured to store, at least once, the location information corresponding to the trajectory determined by the visual analysis means (10). The control means (14) is configured so as to, in the absence of a determined trajectory, control the positioning means (8) according to said stored trajectory. The present invention also relates to a method of guidance.

title: TRAVEL ASSISTANCE SYSTEM FOR AGRICULTURAL MACHINE
abstract: This travel assistance system (S) for an agricultural machine (1) comprises: a position detection device (40) which detects the position of the agricultural machine (1); a reference creation unit (53j) which is positioned in front of the agricultural machine (1) and creates a determination reference (X) for determining turning of the agricultural machine (1); an area discrimination unit (53l) which discriminates between a first area (e1), which is a region where the agricultural machine (1) circulates in a predetermined circulation direction and where a work device (2) performs work, and a second area (e2), which is adjacent to the first area (e1) in a field (H) and into which the agricultural machine (1) is prohibited in advance from intruding; and a first setting unit (53m) which, when the determination reference (X) is positioned in the second area (e2), sets a first turning portion (CR1) between the agricultural machine (1) and the second area (e2) where the agricultural machine (1) will turn to the first area.

title: Enhanced automated steering system for a vehicle
abstract: An automated steering system for an agricultural vehicle operating in a row crop field. The automated steering system includes a correction system having a controller and an alignment sensor. The alignment sensor is disposed between two adjacently spaced crop rows and generates output signals indicative of the alignment sensor's lateral position relative to the two adjacently spaced crop rows as the vehicle advances in the forward direction of travel. The controller receives the generated output signals from the alignment sensor and determines an offset distance of said alignment sensor from a centerline between the two adjacently spaced crop rows. The controller outputs a modified vehicle position signal corresponding to the latitude and longitude position received from said GPS receiver shifted by the offset distance. The vehicle's on board navigation controller causes the vehicles on-board steering control system to steer the vehicle based on the modified vehicle position signal.

title: A FILTER UNIT FOR REMOVING PARTICULATE FROM A SLURRY
abstract: An automated computer-controlled sampling system and related methods for collecting, processing, and analyzing agricultural samples for various chemical properties such as plant available nutrients. The sampling system allows multiple samples to be processed and analyzed for different analytes or chemical properties in a simultaneous concurrent or semi-concurrent manner. Advantageously, the system can process soil samples in the 'as collected' condition without drying or grinding. The system generally includes a sample preparation sub-system which receives soil samples collected by a probe collection sub-system and produces a slurry (i.e. mixture of soil, vegetation, and/or manure and water), and a chemical analysis sub-system which processes the prepared slurry samples for quantifying multiple analytes and/or chemical properties of the sample. The sample preparation and chemical analysis sub-systems can be used to analyze soil, vegetation, and/or manure samples.

title: METHODS AND SYSTEMS FOR WEED CONTROL
abstract: A method of weed control is provided. The method comprising: (a) determining development of flowers of at least one weed species of interest; and (b) artificially pollinating at flowering the flowers of the at least one weed species of interest with pollen that reduces fitness of the at least one weed species of interest. Also provided are systems for executing the method.

title: COMPUTER-IMPLEMENTED METHOD FOR PROVIDING OPERATION DATA FOR TREATMENT DEVICES ON AN AGRICULTURAL FIELD, CORRESPONDING SYSTEMS, USE AND COMPUTER ELEMENT
abstract: A computer-implemented method for providing operation data for treatment devices (102, 104, 106, 107) on an agricultural field (112), wherein the treatment devices include at least a first treatment device (102) and a second treatment device (104) for treating the agricultural field, the method comprising the steps: obtaining field data for at least one section (113) of the agricultural field at least by the first treatment device, wherein the obtained field data indicates a monitoring and treatment status associated with the at least one section; based on the monitoring and treatment status associated with the at least one section providing operation data associated with the at least one section of the agricultural field for the second treatment device.

title: Discovering farming practices
abstract: One embodiment provides a method, including: training a machine-learning model to produce customized farming practices specific to a farm to increase crop yield; wherein the training includes obtaining, from remote sensed data, (i) information corresponding to a crop of each of a plurality of farms and (ii) information corresponding to farming practices of each of the plurality of farms; wherein the training further includes detecting, from the remote sensed data, geographical features and farming characteristics of each of the plurality of farms; wherein the machine-learning model identifies from relationships between (iii) crop information and farming practices and (iv) geographical features and farming characteristics; and discovering, for a specific farm in an identified geographical location, utilizing the trained machine-learning model, and from farm-specific remote-sensed data, farming practices.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR MEASURING THE ROUGHNESS OF A GROUND SURFACE
abstract: A system measures the roughness of the ground surface over which an agricultural implement (10) passes as measured in the direction of travel (22). The system includes at least one ground sensor (40, 42) attached to the agricultural implement (10) that provides measurement of the distance to the ground. A controller (80) is connected to the at least one ground sensor (40, 42), and controls at least one adjustment of the agricultural implement (10). The at least one ground sensor (40, 42) provides instantaneous output (OFGS, ORGS) based on the distance to the ground to the controller (80). The controller (80) then calculates at least one statistical parameter (AVRGS, AVFGS, AAV) from the instantaneous output (OFGS, ORGS). The at least one statistical parameter (AVRGS, AVFGS, AAV) is calculated from variations in the distance to the ground in the direction of travel (22) of the agricultural implement (10).

title: AGRICULTURAL WORK MACHINE, AGRICULTURAL WORK MACHINE CONTROL PROGRAM, RECORDING MEDIUM ON WHICH AGRICULTURAL WORK MACHINE CONTROL PROGRAM IS RECORDED, AND AGRICULTURAL WORK MACHINE CONTROL METHOD
abstract: An agricultural work machine wherein, when a control mode of a traveling control unit is a first mode, the traveling control unit controls the traveling of a machine body on the basis of a reference orientation TA or a traveling course GL calculated on the basis of the reference orientation TA; when the control mode of the traveling control unit is a second mode, the machine body travels according to the operation of a steering operation tool; a straight advancing determination unit that, when the control mode of the traveling control unit is the second mode, determines whether the machine body has advanced straight over the span of a prescribed distance D1 or a prescribed amount of time, is comprised; and if it is determined by the straight advancing determination unit that the machine body has advanced straight over the span of the prescribed distance D1 or the prescribed amount of time, an orientation decision unit decides the reference orientation TA on the basis of the direction of the straight advancing carried out over the span of the prescribed distance D1 or the prescribed amount of time.

title: PNEUMATIC SEED METER FOR SOYBEAN SEEDS
abstract: The present invention relates in general to precision agriculture. More specifically, the invention relates to systems for metering and distributing seeds in planting fields. The invention relates to a pneumatic seed metering device (1) that provides optimized seed distribution for planting soybeans, this meter releasing the soybean seeds by vacuum cut-off and letting the seeds fall through the action of gravity, having to this end a seed disc (2) provided with a plurality of seed orifices (3) spaced radially along a seed passage region, the seed disc (2) being actuated by means of a peripheral region of the seed disc (2), characterized in that the plurality of seed orifices (3) is arranged in a single row with a distance between two adjacent seed orifices (3), the length of which ranges between 2.1 and 3.5 times the diameter of one of the seed orifices (3), the diameter of the orifices being defined within a range of 3.5 to 4.5 mm.

title: Household portable automatic watering equipment with Internet of Things
abstract: The invention discloses household portable automatic watering equipment with Internet of Things.
