The equipment comprises a base, wherein a water storage cavity is formed in the base; a telescopic rodis fixedly connected with the upper end of the base; a telescopic end of the telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a transverse plate arranged along the horizontal direction; an angle adjustment device is fixedly connected with the end part of the transverse plate, and is provided with a sprayer; a fixed plate is fixedly connected with the side wall of the telescopic rod; an annular groove is formed in the upper end face of the fixed plate; the lower end of the fixed plate is in rotating connection with a roller which can rotate along the annular groove; a connecting piece is fixedly connected with the side wall of the telescopic rod; the roller is in rotating connection with the lower end face of the connecting piece; and a nutrient solution extrusion mechanism is arranged on the fixedplate. The equipment combines the Internet of Things with household watering equipment, can be used for automatically watering according to the plant growing situation and supplying nutrient solutionto plants to favor plant growth.

title: Coastal salinized soft soil desalting method and intelligent water storage system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of salinized soft soil desalination, and discloses a coastal salinized soft soil desalination method and an intelligent water storage system.The method comprises the steps that land is arranged into a plurality of units according to the plane size; then water is supplemented to the aquifer, the water moves upwards along with the capillary action, salt moves upwards, after the water reaches the surface layer, the water evaporates, and the salt remains on the surface layer; before rainfall, the rainproof cloth is automatically unfolded to prevent rainwater from entering desalted soil; meanwhile, rainwater is collected by the rain cloth, converged into the drainage ditch and flows into the water storage pond for normal irrigation of plants; the intelligent water storage system comprises a horizontal frame, an electric stretching structure, a shed frame, a piece of rainproof cloth, a water storage pond and an intelligent control box. The raindrop sensor can monitor the raining condition in real time, intelligent unfolding or folding of the rain shielding cloth is achieved, the design is ingenious, and the desalting effect is guaranteed; the rotational flow pipe rotates to form a vortex flowing effect, the water flow speed can be increased, and rainwater collected in the rainwater flow guide combined pipe can be rapidly discharged.

title: Proportioning-adjustable unmanned aerial vehicle variable-rate fertilizer discharging device
abstract: A proportion-adjustable unmanned aerial vehicle variable fertilizer apparatus comprises a rack and a fertilizer spreading disc, a fertilizer preparation disc is fixed on the top of the rack, a fertilizer carrying cylinder and a mounting shaft are fixed on the fertilizer preparation disc, the axes of the mounting shaft, the fertilizer carrying cylinder and the fertilizer preparation disc coincide, a fertilizer preparation fan is arranged on the mounting shaft and divides an inner cavity of the fertilizer carrying cylinder into a plurality of fertilizer preparation bins, and the fertilizer spreading disc is fixed on the rack. A plurality of fertilizer dispersing openings are formed in the fertilizer preparation disc and are in one-to-one correspondence with the fertilizer preparation bins; in conclusion, according to prescription map information, the rotating speeds of the driving motors of the independent fertilizer apparatuses corresponding to the four element fertilizer sub-bins and the phases of the telescopic keys, namely the rotating speeds and the working lengths of the grooved wheel groups, are adjusted, so that the ratio-adjustable double-variable fertilizer discharge of the multi-element fertilizer is realized; according to the invention, a prescription map-based unmanned aerial vehicle automatic variable fertilizer discharge technology with an adjustable fertilizer loading ratio is adopted, so that precise application of a plurality of element fertilizers is realized.

title: AGRICULTURAL VEHICLE
abstract: To provide an agricultural vehicle capable of low in the center of gravity and stable travel.SOLUTION: An agricultural vehicle 1 has a crawler travel part 10, a support base frame, a longitudinal structure, an engine, a hydraulic pump, a tank frame and an injection nozzle unit 56. The crawler travel part 10 travels so as to sandwich a plant 100 in the left-right direction. The support base frame is arranged in a left-right pair, and is respectively overlapped with the left-right crawler travel part 10 in a plan view. A front-rear structures respectively include a left frame, a right frame and a connection frame. An engine is arranged in any one of the left-right support base frames. The hydraulic pump is arranged on the same side as the engine among the left-right support base frames, and is driven by the engine. A hydraulic oil tank is positioned on opposite side in the left-right direction to the left support base frame for arranging the engine, and stores hydraulic oil supplied to the hydraulic pump.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Instant pesticide concentration modulation platform
abstract: The invention relates to an instant pesticide concentration modulation platform which comprises an aerial photographing camera which is arranged on an agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle and is usedfor photographing a wheat planting area below so as to obtain and output a corresponding instant aerial photographing image; a pesticide storage tank which is located in the agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle and is composed of two adjacent containers, wherein the two containers are used for containing the pesticide raw materials and the purified water respectively; and a pesticide spraying mechanism which is arranged on the agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle and is used for determining the concentration of the sprayed pesticide based on the received green pixel percentage and spraying thepesticide with the determined concentration. The instant pesticide concentration modulation platform is customized in structure and is convenient to use. The percentage occupied by the green pixel points in the customized processing image is outputted as the green pixel percentage, and the concentration of the sprayed pesticide is determined on the basis of the green pixel percentage, so that thebalance between the pesticide saving effect and the insecticidal effect is achieved.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle harvesting device having function of automatic bagging
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle harvesting device having a function of automatic bagging. The unmanned aerial vehicle harvesting device having a function of automatic bagging comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, connecting devices, a box body, a mounting plate, a harvester, a conveyer belt, an automatic bagging device and an outlet, wherein the connecting devices are fixedly mounted at the lower end of the unmanned aerial vehicle body; the box body is fixedly mounted at the lower ends of the connecting devices; the mounting plate is fixedly mounted in the box body; theharvester is fixedly mounted on one side of the mounting plate; and the conveyer belt is fixedly mounted in the box body. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle harvesting device having a functionof automatic bagging disclosed by the invention, the automatic bagging device is arranged, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle has the function of automatically bagging harvested crops, and artificially collecting and bagging the crops are not needed, the labor intensity of people is reduced, and the unmanned aerial vehicle harvesting device having a function of automatic bagging is more convenient to use; and the connecting devices are arranged, so that the box body can be convenient to disassemble quickly, repair and maintenance tasks of the harvester or the conveyer belt can be convenient,and the operations are simple and convenient.

title: Linked agricultural harvesting system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention relates to a linked agricultural harvesting system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. The linked agricultural harvesting system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a harvester body, a control processor and an information acquisition mechanism, the unmanned aerial vehicle body comprises a first harvesting mechanism, a flight mechanism and a supporting mechanism and is furtherconnected with a first power device, the harvester body is further connected with a second power device, the information acquisition mechanism comprises a soil humidity detection device, a maturity detection device, a landform detection device and a regional coordinate marker, the supporting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the top of the supporting mechanism is connected with a supporting platform, a storage mechanism is arranged at the top of the harvester body, a first electromagnetic adsorption device is arranged on the periphery of the top of the storage mechanism, a slip channel is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, a second electromagnetic adsorption device is arranged at the bottom of the slip channel, and a photographic device and a gas blowing pump are further arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body.

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR SELECTIVELY HARVESTING TIMBER
abstract: The invention relates to a method for selectively harvesting timber in a timber stand and to an associated felling and/or pruning apparatus (1) which comprises a vehicle (F) and a recording module (3) and a controller (4) which can access data, and the vehicle (F) is moved through the timber stand and selectively carries out felling and pruning, and the recording module (3) captures the stand in the process in order to assist with the navigation of the vehicle (F). The recording module (3) captures at least one decision-making parameter, and the controller (4) therefore makes a decision on the selective felling and pruning in real time.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD OF ASSISTED OR AUTOMATED GRAIN UNLOAD SYNCHRONIZATION
abstract: An agricultural harvester (10) includes a crop processor for reducing crop material to processed crop, an unload conveyor (22) for transferring a stream of processed crop out of the harvester (10), and a camera (28) for capturing images of an area proximate the harvester (10) and generating image data from the captured images. One or more computing devices (44) are configured for receiving the image data from the camera (28), identifying, from the image data, a visual marker (70, 72, 74, 76, 78, 80) corresponding to a receiving vehicle (38), and determining, from the visual marker (70, 72, 74, 76, 78, 80), a location of the receiving vehicle (38) relative to the agricultural harvester (10). An electronic device presents, on a graphical user interface (48) of the device, a graphical representation of the relative locations of the unload conveyor (22) and at least a portion of the receiving vehicle (38), the graphical representation based on the location of the receiving vehicle (38) relative to the agricultural harvester (10) determined by the one or more computing devices (44).

title: METHOD FOR WORKING A FIELD USING AN AGRICULTURAL WORKING MACHINE
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein Verfahren zur Bearbeitung eines Feldes (3) mittels einer landwirtschaftlichen Arbeitsmaschine (1), wobei die landwirtschaftliche Arbeitsmaschine (1) einen Sensor (4) aufweist, der an der landwirtschaftlichen Arbeitsmaschine (1) angeordnet ist, wobei die landwirtschaftliche Arbeitsmaschine (1) ein Fahrerassistenzsystem (5) aufweist, das eine Hinderniskarte (6) aufweist. Es wird vorgeschlagen, dass das Fahrerassistenzsystem (5) die Hinderniskarte (6) mittels des Sensors (4) während der Bearbeitung des Feldes (3) aktualisiert.

title: Plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle with large-range pesticide spraying and fertilizing functions
abstract: The invention discloses a plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle with a large-range pesticide spraying and fertilizing function, and particularly relates to the technical field of plant protection unmanned aerial vehicles; the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a liquid storage tank is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the unmanned aerialvehicle body, and a first bearing is clamped to the lower surface of the liquid storage tank; a connecting cylinder is arranged in the first bearing in a sleeving mode; and two limiting grooves are formed in the inner wall of the connecting cylinder. According to the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle, a driving device, a limiting groove, a threaded column, a spray head, a positioning rod and a limiting strip are arranged, and a plurality of nozzles are formed in the surface of the spray head, so that the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle can quickly spray pesticide in the using process, and the spray head can quickly rotate under the action of a positioning column, a limiting strip and a limiting hole; and thus the spraying range of the pesticide in the spraying range is increased substantially. Due to the fact that the spray head rotates by 360 degrees, dead corners are not prone to being reserved in the pesticide spraying process of the plant protection unmanned aerialvehicle, and the pesticide utilization efficiency of the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle is guaranteed.

title: Method of predicting crop yield loss due to N-deficiency
abstract: A method for determining the yield loss of a crop using remote sensor data is described. The yield loss is determined using the reflectivity of green light by the crop canopy measured from remote sensor data such as an aerial photograph that is digitized and spatially referenced to the field's longitude and latitude. Green pixel values from the aerial photograph, expressed relative to green pixel values from well-fertilized areas of the field, are transformed to yield losses using a linear transformation that was developed using empirical data. A similar method is described to determine recommended nitrogen fertilization rates for the crop fields. The yield loss data is useful for nitrogen fertilization management, as it allows a producer of crops to weigh the expense of fertilization against the loss of revenue due to yield loss.

title: Fertilizer applicator intelligent control system based on Beidou navigation
abstract: The invention discloses a fertilizer applicator intelligent control system based on Beidou navigation. The fertilizer applicator intelligent control system comprises a navigation assembly and a fertilizer proportioning and conveying assembly; the navigation assembly comprises a main control module, a spectrum recognition module connected with the main control module, a GNSS receiver and an ECU balance controller, wherein the ECU balance controller is connected with a movement control module and a speed control module, and the GNSS receiver is further connected with an antenna; and the fertilizer proportioning and conveying assembly comprises a proportioning control module connected with the main control module, the proportioning control module is connected with a driving module and a distributing module, the driving module is connected with a spiral stirrer, the distributing module is connected with a plurality of discharging gates, the multiple discharging gates are all connected witha stirring box, and the spiral stirrer is arranged in the stirring box. A wireless module is used for controlling operation and sending operation items, the main control module and the proportioningmodule are used for controlling fertilizer to achieve the purposes of precise fertilization and variable fertilization; and the main control module is matched with the GNSS receiver, the ECU balance controller and the movement control module to achieve the purpose of automatic control.

title: STEERING CONTROLLER FOR PRECISION FARMING
abstract: A steering controller can control steering of a vehicle and is suitable for precision farm controlling. The steering controller can rotate the steering shaft of the vehicle direct the vehicle on a desired path, for example, using a satellite positioning system. Components of the steering controller are environmental protected by a housing that has an opening extending between its front and rear surfaces. The opening is lined by a shaft. A hub located near the front of the opening can be coupled to the steering shaft of the vehicle. A motor has a stator fixed to the housing and a rotor fixed to the hub. When the housing is attached to a fixed location on the vehicle, the motor can rotate the steering shaft by rotating the hub with respect to the housing. A control module drives the motor based on commands from a guidance module.

title: Method and system for automatically controlling a position of a ground engaging tool of an agricultural implement relative to a ground surface
abstract: A method for automatically controlling a position of one or more ground engaging tools of an agricultural implement is relative to a ground surface may include monitoring a position signal indicative of a position of a ground engaging tool of the implement. The position signal may have an associated system delay time. The method also may include estimating an arrival time when the position of the ground engaging tool will be within a predetermined threshold of a target position based on the monitored position signal and the system delay time associated with the monitored position signal. The method may include adjusting the position of the ground engaging tool and terminating the adjustment of the ground engaging tool at a termination time determined based on the arrival time.

title: Plant identification using heterogenous multi-spectral stereo imaging
abstract: A farming machine identifies and treats a plant as the farming machine travels through a field. The farming machine includes a pair of image sensors for capturing images of a plant. The image sensors are different, and their output images are used to generate a depth map to improve the plant identification process. A control system identifies a plant using the depth map. The control system captures images, identifies a plant, and actuates a treatment mechanism in real time.

title: Pesticide spraying unmanned aerial vehicle based on intelligent agriculture
abstract: The invention discloses a pesticide spraying unmanned aerial vehicle based on intelligent agriculture, which structurally comprises a main body, a pesticide sprayer is mounted below the main body, a carrier frame is arranged in the pesticide sprayer, a shock absorber is arranged below the carrier frame, a fixing plate is mounted in the shock absorber, a slow pressing rod is mounted on the side wall of the fixing plate, the slow pressing rod comprises a connecting and fixing rod, and a spring strip is nested on the connecting and fixing rod. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle landing protection device, through cooperation of the shock absorbers in the carrier frame, when a main unmanned aerial vehicle lands, the fixing plate and a sliding mechanism below the fixing plate are matched for buffering, when the unmanned aerial vehicle lands on the ground, the sliding mechanism is subjected to impact force, and when the unmanned aerial vehicle lands on the ground, the unmanned aerial vehicle is prevented from falling off. The damping rubber sleeve is sleeved with the fixing plate, the organ sleeve is compressed through the fixing plate, the slow pressing rods on the two sides retract at the same time, the spring strips retract in the damping rubber sleeve under extrusion of the built-in disc, the impact force of the main unmanned aerial vehicle at the moment of landing is effectively reduced, and the problems of shaking and unbalance during landing of the unmanned aerial vehicle are solved.

title: Precise agricultural automatic/manual variable fertilizing machine based on virtual GPS (global position system)
abstract: The invention provides a precise agricultural automatic/manual variable fertilizing machine based on a virtual GPS (global position system), which aims at applying fertilizers to soil according to the crop nutrition requirements through the virtual GPS under the circumstance that farmland nutrition space distribution is not uniform so as to achieve the purposes of reducing the input, increasing the benefit and improving the quality of agricultural products. The precise agricultural automatic/manual variable fertilizing machine comprises a virtual GPS navigation system and a variable deep fertilizing and precise sowing machine, wherein the virtual GPS navigation system is separated from the variable deep fertilizing and precise sowing machine and comprises a differential global position system (DGPS), a geographic information and field operation land parcel management system, a field operation land parcel grid identification and control program, and an IC (integrated circuit) card for storing land parcel management and variable fertilization decision information.

title: FIELD REGISTRATION DEVICE, FIELD REGISTRATION METHOD, AND COMPUTER PROGRAM
abstract: The present disclosure is a farm field registration device including: an acquisition device that acquires boundary information for defining a boundary line of a farm field; a control device that creates a farm field map in a predetermined data format based on the boundary information; and a storage device that stores the farm field map, in which the acquisition device acquires division information for defining a division line that divides the farm field into a plurality of divided farm fields each having a plantable area, the control device executes division processing of creating a divided farm field map corresponding to the plurality of divided farm fields based on the division information, and the storage device stores the divided farm field map.

title: Remote sensing image acquisition prevention and control method and system suitable for disease and pest monitoring
abstract: The invention provides a remote sensing image acquisition prevention and control method and system suitable for disease and insect pest monitoring, and the method comprises the steps: collecting a thermal infrared image and a hyperspectral image at a total target region, determining the number of disease and insect pest interested pixel points in the thermal infrared image, and obtaining first disease and insect pest information, determining vegetation interested pixel points in the hyperspectral image to obtain first vegetation information; according to the first vegetation information and the first pest and disease information, calculating average pest and disease information, and according to a pesticide amount deviation value, performing deviation calculation processing on a preset pesticide amount value to obtain a pesticide amount sowing value; performing partition processing on a total target area corresponding to the hyperspectral image to obtain a plurality of first target areas, and obtaining a first disease and pest average pixel value and a first vegetation average pixel value of each first target area; second average speed information and second average height information of each first target area are obtained through calculation; if it is judged that the unmanned aerial vehicle is in the corresponding geographical fence information, the unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to conduct pesticide spraying according to the second average speed information and the second average height information.

title: Monitoring system and monitoring method of seeder
abstract: The invention provides a monitoring system and a monitoring method of a seeder. The system comprises an industrial control machine and a driving motor. The industrial control machine comprises a unitspeed fusion module, a seed arrangement flow monitoring module, a driving motor theoretical rotation speed decision module, a rotation speed deviation inference module, a control parameter setting module, a seed arrangement shaft rotation speed adjustment module and a seed arrangement shaft rotation speed control module. A positioning signal receiver is fixed on the top of a cab, used for receiving a geographical position signal and connected with the driving motor theoretical rotation speed decision module. A speed sensor is installed on a driving wheel of the seeder and used for measuring rotation speed of the driving wheel of the seeder. The speed sensor is connected with the unit speed fusion module. An accelerated speed sensor is installed on the cross beam of the rack of the seeder,used for measuring the accelerated speed of the seeder and connected with the unit speed fusion module. According to the invention, problems in monitoring of unit working state parameters and preciseadjustment and control of seeding quantity can be solved.

title: Agricultural machine control using work quality based on in situ operation sensing
abstract: A method of controlling a mobile agricultural machine that includes performing an agricultural operation during a given pass in a field using a first set of machine settings, obtaining in situ data representing the agricultural operation during the given pass, generating a performance metric based on the in situ data, identifying a second set of machine settings based on the performance metric, and outputting a control instruction that controls the mobile agricultural machine during a subsequent pass in the field based on the second set of machine settings.

title: Community greening planting device based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention discloses a community greening planting device based on the Internet of Things. The planting device comprises: automatic planting equipment, a cloud platform, and a control terminal. The automatic planting equipment comprises: a mechanical unit used for hole drilling, soil taking, tree planting, soil covering and tamping, a single-chip microcomputer, an image acquisition element used for identifying the length of a sapling, a wireless transceiver module, and a power supply module. The single-chip microcomputer controls the wireless transceiver module to perform data interaction with the cloud platform or the wireless transceiver module of adjacent automatic planting equipment. The cloud platform performs data interaction with the control terminal. The single-chip microcomputer controls the mechanical unit to work. According to the device disclosed by the invention, planting can be automatically completed, and the planting efficiency is high; upper and lower layers of soil can be layered, and manual soil separation is not required, so that the operation efficiency is improved; after the upper and lower layers of soil are separated, two different treatments of fertilizing and watering are performed, so that the pertinence is high, and the improvement of the planting quality is facilitated.

title: ULTRASOUND CONTROLLED SPOT SPRAYER AND METHODS FOR CROP PROTECTION
abstract: The present invention relates to a novel apparatus for delivering herbicide and/or fertilizer to row crops that includes an array of ultrasound detector pairs that is aligned perpendicular to the row crops, and a sprayer positioned between the ultrasound detectors of each ultrasound detector pair wherein each of the ultrasound detector pairs has a tunable detection window at a desired distance from the sensor.

title: Liquid adding device for agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a liquid adding device for an agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle. The liquid adding device comprises a box body, a base is fixed to the bottom of the box body, a feeding mechanism and a pressurizing mechanism are fixed to the top of the box body, a liquid guiding mechanism is fixedly inserted into the outer wall of one side of the box body, a liquid adding gun is fixed tothe discharging end of the liquid guiding mechanism, and a transverse plate is fixed to the outer wall of the left side of the base; a sliding groove is formed in one side of the transverse plate, asliding block is clamped in the sliding groove in a sliding mode, a supporting steering mechanism is fixed between the sliding block and the liquid adding gun, a threaded rod is inserted into the sliding block in a threaded mode, and the threaded rod is in transmission connection with a driving mechanism. Liquid adding can be conveniently completed, convenience and rapidness are achieved, and thelabor intensity is reduced.
